Label D is on the left side, and its arrow points to a thin tan/yellow layer of cells just beneath the top green surface layer and above the tall vertical palisade cells. Reasoning: In leaf anatomy, the protective cell layer immediately below the cuticle/top surface and above the palisade layer is the upper epidermis. Therefore, D represents the epidermis.
